scenes.heading: What to do when a platform change threatens your income

sents.d: What to do when a platform change threatens your income
Every platform-dependent creator eventually faces an algorithm shift, policy change, or ban wave.

Treating any single platform as inherently temporary — even a currently-thriving one — and building an email list, website, or owned audience alongside it is the most reliable protection against a sudden platform change wiping out your reach overnight.

When a change does hit, resisting the urge to panic-pivot your entire content strategy overnight and instead making measured adjustments while watching what's actually working again tends to recover faster than a complete strategy reset.
Diversified income (memberships, products, brand deals across platforms, an email list) means a single platform's bad month is a setback, not a business-ending event.

take: Build owned channels and diversified income before you need them.
